summary: The Enterprise Data Architect designs the organization-wide data strategy, ensuring integration, quality, and governance of data assets across all systems.
responsibilities: Define enterprise data architecture, standards, and best practices
Align data strategy with business goals and analytics needs
Oversee integration across transactional, analytical, and big data systems
Ensure compliance, security, and regulatory adherence
Guide teams on data architecture design and implementation

education: 10+ years of experience in data architecture across multiple systems

skills_required.name: Cloud, big data, and traditional data warehousing expertise
